name: Houzz Pro
summary: Business management for design and construction pros with CRM, proposals, estimates, takeoffs, 3D floor plans and lead generation.
differentiator: Built around client-facing proposals, CRM and lead generation, with estimating and takeoffs attached, rather than around commercial bid invitations. Pricing differs a lot by source: Starter reported at $65 to $85, Pro at $199 and Ultimate at $399 to $499 per month, with extra users at $60 per month in one source.
pricing: Not confirmed on the vendor page. Third-party sources report Starter $65 to $85, Essential $99 to $129, Pro $199 and Ultimate $399 to $499 per month, with extra users reported at $60 per month.
whoPays: Subscriber pays per plan plus per extra user
bestFor: Remodelers and designers who want leads, CRM and estimates in one tool.
skipIf: You respond to commercial invitations to bid and level sub quotes.
